body.statement: Construct \(\mathfrak A\) so that the unrestricted real parameter space of every \(\pi\in\mathfrak S_3\) is partitioned into finitely many semialgebraic strata on each of which the fiber of \(\widetilde\Phi_{\le3}\) has a certified constant cardinality and a certified set of chain orders. For every singleton-order stratum, provide an observable rational chart for \(u\) and \(v\); for every non-singleton or positive-dimensional stratum, provide explicit real parameter twins or a fiber parameterization. Determine on all intersections of rank-drop and denominator-zero hypersurfaces whether the failure of \(\operatorname{Rec}\) is removable or is genuine nonidentification.
body.justification: This exposes the genuine unresolved content instead of equating one failed rational denominator with structural ambiguity.
body.gap: Generic elimination in Tramontano et al. (2025) and Garcia-Puente et al. (2010) does not classify real fibers on exceptional intersections; Drton, Foygel, and Sullivant (2011) do not cover this higher-moment latent LiNGAM map.
body.consumer: A completed atlas yields exact ambiguity warnings and alternate formulas for observations near every failure divisor of the cubic branch.

obligation.what_is_open: A finite real-primary-decomposition atlas for every six-chain fiber of the full second-and-third-moment map, including every intersection of rank-drop, sign-boundary, and denominator-zero strata.
obligation.obstruction: The frozen primitives provide the positive chart and the formal atlas handle but no real primary decomposition or complete solutions of the six exceptional polynomial systems. Vanishing of a displayed denominator is insufficient because alternate adjugate or kernel charts can remove some failures, while full-moment ambiguity requires covariance-compatible twins rather than cubic-only twins.
obligation.attempted: Derived the exact fixed-order rank, determinant, sign, and denominator loci; constructed an alternate kernel chart at the removable y-zero failure; and exhibited a coefficient-changing cubic boundary fiber at zero root-residual skewness. The pinned Macaulay2 executable and file were not available in this environment, so the requested all-stratum CAS decomposition and localized intersection audit could not be regenerated.
obligation.partial_result:
For a fixed order \(\pi=(a,b,c)\), the cubic identities are polynomial identities and therefore remain valid for arbitrary real parameter values.  Writing \(K=hxr\), they give
\[
k=(-uz,z+vy,-y)^{\mathsf T},
\qquad
N=K(uyz,-y(z+vy),y^2)^{\mathsf T},
\]
\[
W=-Ktyz(0,1,v)^{\mathsf T},
\qquad
W_b=-Ktyz,
\qquad
D=K^2ty^2z^2.
\]
Thus the displayed adjugate-column chart recovers \(u\) and \(v\) whenever \(hrtx y z\ne0\).  The root slice has rank two exactly when \(hxr\ne0\) and \((y,z)\ne(0,0)\).  The other slice determinants are
\[
\det(M_b)=hrtu pz^2
\]
and
\[
\det(M_c)=hrtu v^2qz^2+hrwuvqy^2+htwvqx^2+rtwuv^2.
\]
Away from zero kernel coordinates, the fixed sign rule selects \(b\) exactly on the chamber
\[
uz(z+vy)>0,
\qquad
uzy>0.
\]
The failure at \(y=0\) is removable when \(hxrtz\ne0\): then \(k=(-uz,z,0)^{\mathsf T}\) and
\[
M_bk=tz(0,1,v)^{\mathsf T},
\qquad
v=\frac{(M_bk)_c}{(M_bk)_b},
\qquad
u=-\frac{k_a}{k_b+vk_c}.
\]
Hence a nonzero adjugate column other than the \(c\)-column supplies a valid chart.  There is also a genuine cubic boundary fiber at \(r=0\): for any nonzero \(\Delta\), replacing
\[
u\longmapsto u+\Delta,
\qquad
y\longmapsto y-x\Delta
\]
keeps \(p=ux+y\) and \(q=vp+z\) fixed, and because the \(rd^{\otimes3}\) term is absent it keeps \(C_3\) fixed while changing \(u\).  This last witness concerns the cubic component; it does not by itself certify equality of the covariance component of the full unrestricted moment map.  These results certify the principal fixed-order charts and distinguish one removable chart failure from one genuine cubic ambiguity, but they do not constitute the requested all-order real primary-decomposition atlas.
